recipes.name: Red Velvet Latte
instructions: Mix all of the powdered mix ingredients together in a bowl or a jar*.
To make each latte, add 1½ Tbsp of the powdered mix to a cup and pour over 2 Tbsp (30 mL) of boiling water. Stir to dissolve.
Then pour in 1 cup (240 mL) of hot barista oat milk. Top with foamed milk if desired, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Beetroot powder has a naturally grainy texture which may be noticeable in the drink. If you'd prefer to use fresh beetroots, try our other beetroot latte recipe instead! Find it using our search feature. † Vanilla sugar is granulated sugar infused with vanilla beans, commonly used in European kitchens. It can easily be substituted with regular granulated sugar and a splash of vanilla extract. † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk that is fortified with calcium . * Make-ahead: in the photos, we batch-made 8 servings of the powdered mix. Simply use the scaling feature to scale the recipe to your desired number of servings.
Storage The drink is best if enjoyed immediately. If making a large batch of the dry powdered mix, store in a sealed mason jar in a cool and dry place for up to 6 months.
